abstract: V Česku je tisíc obcí bezprostředně ohrožených suchem. Vyplývá to ze seznamu, který sestavil Český hydrometeorologický ústav (ČHMÚ). Ministerstvo životního prostředí pro ně vyhradilo půl miliardy korun ze Státního fondu životního prostředí.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02767-xExtreme southward swings of the South Indian convergence zone can lead to severe rainfall and flooding in southern Africa. Here the authors show that climate change leads to an increase in the frequency and intensity of such swings.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02766-yClean hydrogen is a versatile decarbonization option, but given its energy-intensive production, high costs and limited near-term supply, uses with the greatest environmental and economic benefits must be prioritized. Analysis of ten end-use sectors identifies high-value applications and suggests that uniform supply-side subsidies risk misallocating clean hydrogen and public funds, highlighting the need for sector-specific demand-side policies.

Klimatologové v nové studii zdůrazňují drastické následky probíhající fáze El Niño. Iniciativa Climate Impact Lab uvádí, že extrémní počasí, které jev působí, může zapříčinit smrt přes 450 000 lidí. Lidstvo se navíc bude muset přizpůsobit extrémním teplotám, které budou podle výzkumníků do dvaceti let novou normou.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02770-2A resilient society must prepare not only for common harms but also for uncommon vulnerabilities, such as rare disease where the consequences leave no room for failure. Ensuring that people with rare diseases have reliable access to essential care is crucial for fairness and safety in a changing climate.

With energy-related carbon dioxide emissions remaining at high levels, decarbonizing commercial building operations across key economies is critical for achieving global climate targets. This study assesses future operational carbon trajectories, mitigation potential, and the driving factors of this potential in commercial building operations across 16 countries from 2024 to 2060 by combining a Kaya-based emission model and Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis. Over the past two decades, the lack of an MeV $γ$-ray all-sky instrument has left an observational gap in blazar broadband emission. Recently, a new suite of MeV $γ$-ray instruments with sensitivity in the $10^{-11}$ to $10^{-12}$ $\mathrm{erg/cm^{2}/s}$ range has been proposed, with the potential to far surpass the capabilities of previous all-sky MeV instruments. In this work, we forecast the capabilities of future MeV $γ$-ray instruments including COSI, GRAMS, newASTROGAM, and AMEGO-X to observe blazars.

We present a near-infrared spectroscopic follow-up study of seven H$α$ emitter candidates at $z\sim2$ in the ZFOURGE-COSMOS field, selected via the $K_{\rm s}$-band flux excess method. Spectra obtained with Subaru/SWIMS confirm strong H$α$ emission line at $z=2.06-2.49$ for all the targets. Three galaxies are low-mass systems ($\log(M_\star/M_\odot) < 9$) with high specific SFRs, while four are high-mass systems ($\log(M_\star/M_\odot) > 10$) on the star-forming main sequence.

Within general-relativistic descriptions, the no-hair theorem dictates that black-hole geometries possess just three intrinsic physical quantities: mass, angular momentum, and electric charge. Black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) are equivalent to those composed of anisotropic matter and can develop "hair" structures near the event horizon, serving as ideal testbeds for modified theories of gravity. Working within Einsteinian gravitational theory, we adopt a coupling construction between gravity and NED matter, focusing explicitly ...

Detailed UV-to-optical studies of galaxies at z >= 10 have largely focused on bright systems (MUV <= -20 mag), leaving intrinsically faint galaxies virtually unexplored to date. Combining NIRCam, NIRSpec, and MIRI imaging and spectroscopy, we investigate UNCOVER-ABELL2744-13151 (U13151), an ultra-faint galaxy at z = 9.7995 (MUV = -17.44 mag), magnified by Abell 2744 ($μ$ = 12.8). U13151 is very blue ($β$ ~ -2.64), ultra-low mass (log10(M*/Msun) ~ 6.68), young (~ 5.5 Myr), metal-poor (Z ~ 3-6% Zsun), and compact (Re ~ 122 pc).

Hydrodynamic models could supply forward-looking depth guidance, but they are typically run offline for historical events, and prior studies have not evaluated whether physics-based simulation, spatial serving, and vehicle-aware routing can operate together within a fixed refresh cycle using a cloud solver and a single commodity server. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. Conventional km-scale climate models give greatly increased realism compared to typical global climate models (GCMs) but are too computationally costly to allow enough simulations for robustly quantifying changes in extremes. The research addresses temporal patterns, system-resource relationships, attack vulnerability, and anomaly detection. Life is a rhythmic process driven by cellular and physiological mechanisms that allow plants to respond and adapt to their environment. In addition to natural fluctuations, plants are increasingly exposed to environmental stresses, mainly caused by climate change and anthropogenic pollution. Multiple approaches across different biological scales (gene, cell, metabolite, and physiology) have shed light on acclimation mechanisms but generally lack sufficient temporal resolution.

The interaction between human infrastructures and external events results in loss of functionality or even complete system disruption through a snowball effect of cascading-failures. Their complex interplay challenges their prevention, affecting the human population that rely on their functionality. Understanding how these networks respond to external perturbations is crucial for predicting and mitigating the impacts of disruptive events.

The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

Mimořádné sucho dál sužuje jih Anglie. Vodní nádrž Ardingly, která slouží k zásobování přibližně 280 tisíc odběratelů, je naplněná už jen z necelé pětiny. Dramatický úbytek vody zachycují čtvrteční záběry z dronu.

Riziko návratu kůrovcové kalamity: Sucho, teplo a přemnožená zvěř zvyšují riziko, že české lesy příští rok znovu zasáhne kůrovcová kalamita. Rozhodující bude počasí na jaře, kdy se kůrovec rojí – pokud mu podmínky umožní dvě až tři generace, může se situace výrazně zhoršit. Tvrdý dopad na houbaře i vstup do lesa: Pokud se na jaře vyvinou dvě až tři generace škůdce, hrozí plošná těžba, bezpečnostní zákazy vstupu pro veřejnost a citelný úbytek lesních hub.

Scientists have discovered that some forest soils are becoming surprisingly better at removing methane from the atmosphere as temperatures rise and rainfall declines. A study spanning up to 24 years found methane absorption increasing by an average of 3% annually, challenging previous predictions about climate change's effects on forests.

Ani chladnější podzimní počasí a občasné srážky zatím Česku nepřinesly úlevu od sucha. Vidět je to zejména na vysychajících vodních tocích a přehradách. Deník N přináší obrazové srovnání jejich letošního a loňského stavu z ptačí perspektivy.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02778-8This year, all three major Rio Conventions — on biodiversity, climate and desertification — convene their respective Conference of the Parties (COP). In advance of the biodiversity COP17, Astrid Schomaker, the executive secretary of the Convention on Biological Diversity, discusses the irrefutable need to integrate biodiversity conservation into broader environmental action to ensure local and global security and prosperity in a rapidly changing world.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02792-wIn a year containing summits from the three United Nations environmental frameworks, we consider how cooperation across the Conferences of the Parties (COPs) can facilitate implementation and impact. Co-timed with the start of the biodiversity COP, we highlight the reciprocal relationship between climate change and biodiversity.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02775-xClimate change will further increase the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events. Subjective experience and attribution of extreme weather events to climate change, rather than objective exposure alone, are associated with greater climate-relevant attention and choices. Political affiliation influences attention and behaviour irrespective of subjective attribution and objective exposure.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02765-zMechanisms behind climate decision-making remain unclear. This study shows that political affiliation and subjective attribution shape attention allocation and climate-related choices, with subjective attribution moderating the effects of political affiliation and objective weather exposure.

Česko už ví, jaká místa jsou nejohroženější akutním nedostatkem vody. Český hydrometeorologický ústav zmapoval zhruba tisíc takových lokalit. Ministerstvo pro ně vyhradilo půl miliardy na akutní opatření.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02757-zA distributional analysis of European Union climate policy pathways traces the costs of reducing carbon dioxide emissions to the level of households based on their spending and income patterns. We find that different equity considerations, including income inequality and within-group impact divergence, can shape optimal climate policy design with carbon prices, transfers, standards and subsidies.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02781-zThe role of wind in ecosystem water use efficiency remains unclear. The authors show that water use efficiency declines with increasing wind speed, driven mainly by increases in evapotranspiration and secondarily by reductions in gross primary productivity.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02782-yMarine radar signal propagation is highly sensitive to fine-scale vertical changes in water vapour. Now research shows that long-term increases in sea surface temperatures are strengthening the frequency and intensity of the features that allow radar signals to travel further than expected.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02774-yAtmospheric ducts are waveguides that affect electromagnetic propagation in the atmosphere, affecting radar and other technologies. Here the authors show that warming intensifies such ducting over mid- to low-latitude oceans.

Nature Climate Change, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02763-1Clean hydrogen is widely proposed for hard-to-abate sector decarbonization, but its limited supply requires prioritizing sectors with the highest value. This study evaluates ten sectors and identifies key no-regret uses, while highlighting the need for specific demand-side policies.

Nature Sustainability, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01939-zDeforestation-reducing development pathways may cut emissions, but it is unclear how workers can adapt given skill and geographic mobility constraints. Modelling job transitions in Brazil reveals that greener pathways benefit workers in high-skill occupations but increase low-skill unemployment, mitigated by mobility policies.

Nature Sustainability, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01971-zClimate action reshapes who gains and loses from energy and environmental resources, raising new geopolitical questions. A study now quantifies four climate-related asset types across 169 countries and reveals uneven asset redistribution, with major powers often less affected.
Sucho decimuje lesy. Ničí stromky i vzrostlé stromy, u nichž se ale škody teprve projeví. Hrozí totiž návrat kůrovcové kalamity, kterou způsobuje hlavně brouk lýkožrout smrkový.

I když byl poslední týden po babím létu trochu deštivější, stále v Česku přetrvává nedostatek srážek. Stále se vyskytuje půdní sucho, a to zejména v jižních částech našeho území, a v řekách i přehradách chybí voda a často jsou na historicky nízkých hladinách. Následující dny ani týdny situaci nejspíš nezlepší, protože vydatnější srážky jsou v nedohlednu.

Galaxies do not form in isolation, but rather as part of a wider interconnected web mediated at their interface by an extended gaseous atmosphere - the Circum-Galactic Medium (CGM). This dynamic and multiphase region is fed and shaped by gas inflows and mergers from the intergalactic medium and by feedback-driven outflows and radiation from the central galaxy. The CGM is imprinted by the past, present and future evolution of its central galaxy and environment.

This observational bias impedes our assessment of how universal chemical complexity is during star formation. Bursty or (rotation-induced) pulsed coherent radio emission from pulsars, magnetars, and fast radio transients originates in some of the most extreme environments in the Universe. However, the exact physical mechanism behind the scenes remains poorly understood. ALMA2040 will allow for systematic exploration of the millimeter-wavelength spectral window for pulsars and fast radio transients for the very first time, offering unprecedented opportunities to discover new observational phenomena and advance our understanding of emission physics.

Faulty sensor readings can distort estimates of fuel use and carbon dioxide emissions from diesel engines. We evaluate two procedures that use relationships learned from healthy measurements to diagnose faults and guide fuel correction. The diagnosis procedure tests whether replacing a suspected faulty reading with an estimated healthy value helps a model predict another sensor's recorded reading more accurately.

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. Machine learning algorithms analyze satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and promote sustainable development.

Podzimní období si většina lidí spojí se sychravým počasím, ranními mlhami, ale hlavně častými dešti a mrholením. Letošní podzim je však podle meteorologů na míle vzdálený zažitým představám. Podle map s předpovědí pro Evropu spadne v Česku jen pár milimetrů srážek.
